question: What does the original paratext of the NLC accession labelled 1599 establish about Xu An and the date scope of the same accession's juan 45 variant, and can the SYSU holding be bound to an exact item?
method: Downloaded public holding-attributed PDF bytes, visually read selected original pages without OCR, and hashed PDFs and raw embedded image streams. PDF page indices are one-based. Companion front and rear fascicles are attributed to the same NLC accession 411999015732, not additional independent witnesses.

selected_original_pages.visual_reading: Left leaf closes the first preface with 李維楨.
Right leaf closes Wang's preface with 萬曆庚子春三月 and 王邦俊拜撰. The same leaf names 郡守徐君, 倅馬君 and 司理胡君, then refers to 梓而傳之. Left leaf begins 古今律曆考自敘.
Right leaf closes 邢雲路's self-preface and left leaf starts the next preface.
Right leaf closes 滿城魏文魁識; left leaf starts the table of contents.
Right leaf ends juan 72 with 古今律曆考卷七十二畢; left leaf opens 古今律曆考後敘.

Right leaf refers to 壽諸梓. Left leaf ends the postface with 萬曆歲在屠維大淵獻律中黃鐘 and the names/titles 延安府知府 and 徐安. 屠維 = 己; 大淵獻 = 亥; within Wanli this is 己亥 (1599 by reign year), distinct from a Gregorian day conversion.
Right leaf continues Xu's signature with 首拜書; left leaf opens the next postface.
Left leaf ends Ma's postface with 延安府同知屬下吏馬英 and 頓首拜書.

ncl_06271_paratext_comparator.catalogue_scope: 徐安1600, call number 305.3 06271, extant juan 1–26; therefore eligible for front-matter comparison and ineligible as juan 45 evidence.

selected_original_pages.visual_reading: Right leaf preserves the same Wang 邦俊 signature, 庚子 spring third month and the passage referring to 徐、馬、胡 and 梓而傳之; left leaf begins Ma's postface, which appears at the back of the NLC accession.
Ma's closing signature and local column arrangement agree with the selected NLC fascicle 28 p36 leaf at the observed locus.

ncl_06271_paratext_comparator.limit: Shared passage and local layout provide a bounded paratext comparison. Different neighboring texts and positions are observed. No plate identity, priority or direction of transmission is inferred.

ju45_binding.interpretation: The accession has a Xu An postface dated 1599 and a Wang Bangjun preface dated 1600. The observed assemblage includes a paratext dated 1600; those dates support dated editorial and publication context, without dating the target juan 45 sheets, their blocks, or the current binding. The catalogue-assigned 1599 label remains explicitly a catalogue label.
unresolved: Same or distinct plates versus complete Taiwan NCL 06270 and the SYSU holding
Independently legible L132 rate and source-native 疾 coefficient construction

sysu_calis.method_and_filters: Anonymous read-only POST via the public front-end's title endpoint, both unscoped and with new_library=[ZSU].
sysu_calis.interpretation: A provider-issued library filter was verified. The title endpoint returned an access/result boundary in this environment; no holding absence or login requirement can be inferred. SYSU item identifier, source-native target leaf and copying terms remain unverified.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: Using the 1599 catalogue label or the Xu postface alone to assert that the entire surviving accession or its juan 45 sheets were printed in 1599.
unresolved_lineage_questions: Whether the shared Wang and Ma paratext layouts reflect shared blocks, recutting, or another relationship; the surviving 06271 lacks the relevant juan 45 leaves.

next_action: Seek complete-copy NCL 06270 or SYSU source-issued juan 45 folios; compare physically anchored paratext and target table sheets separately. Seek original 疾-specific construction and an independently legible L132 rate.
